input.claim_summary: Policyholder Sam Patel (POL-1004) returned from a work trip to find their entire basement flooded with approximately 2 inches of water from a failure in their own plumbing. Damage includes buckled hardwood floors spanning the full basement, soaked drywall up to 1 foot high, and ruined stored contents. Severity assessed as HIGH — likely exceeds $25,000 and requires on-site inspection, professional water extraction, mold remediation, flooring replacement, and drywall repair. Policy is active with a $500 deductible and $750,000 coverage limit.
